description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model to use for this agent. If not specified, inherits from parent. Prefer lighter models for quick, straightforward tasks to minimize cost and latency.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for the subagent's model. If not specified, uses the subagent config's reasoning_effort or the model default.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set to false only when you must block and wait for the agent's final report inline. Background runs return a task ID/output file and deliver a task notification on completion.

agent_id.description: Deploy an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Starts a new conversation with that agent.

conversation_id.description: Resume from an existing conversation. Does NOT require agent_id (conversation IDs are unique and encode the agent).

backend.description: Override the backend used for the subagent child process. By default the subagent inherits the parent's backend. Set to "local" when a cloud agent needs to deploy a local agent (agent_id starting with "agent-local-"). Only meaningful with agent_id.

memory_blocks.description: Memory file paths to inject into the subagent's prompt as context. Overrides the subagent config's memoryBlocks default. Only supported by subagent types that declare memoryBlocks in their frontmatter.
